episodes.title: Chapter One: Cerebral LOLzy
episodes.summary: In the wake of being hit by a car, Ryan begins a coveted internship and finds an opportunity to redefine himself based on his recent run-in.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Deep End
episodes.summary: Kim encourages a daunted Ryan to be more comfortable with his body at Olivia's pool party, where they both make some surprising new friends.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Free Scones
episodes.summary: Karen reluctantly agrees to help Ryan find an apartment while Kim eagerly volunteers to help him check another big milestone off his list.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Housechilling Party
episodes.summary: Ryan's underwhelming attempt at a housewarming party leads to a bonding session with Kim. Karen's nest doesn't stay empty for long.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Vagina Momologues
episodes.summary: Karen's shopping trip is cut short as she tends to pressing matters for her mother and Ryan, fueling frustrations with her role as dual-caregiver.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: Straight Potential
episodes.summary: While Ryan attends a dudes' poker night, Karen lets loose with Phil at home, basking in her affection for him -- and for grilled cheese.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: Blind Deaf Date
episodes.summary: An unconventional blind date leads Ryan to examine his own biases and insecurities. Friction develops in Karen and Phil's burgeoning romance.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: Gay Gardens
episodes.summary: Conflicted by how he's being defined, Ryan decides to come clean at work and with his friends. But focusing on himself leaves Karen feeling left out.

episodes.title: One Day Stand
episodes.summary: A night out leads Ryan to an exciting but complicated new connection. As Karen longs for reconciliation with her son, Kim questions their dynamic.

episodes.title: I Don't Like It Like This
episodes.summary: As Ryan and Kim try to unpack their respective romantic situations, Ryan's gets an unexpected new wrinkle. Karen catches up with an old friend.

episodes.title: That's the Way the Boys Are
episodes.summary: On the night of Kim's birthday bash, she and Ryan find themselves at a crossroads. Karen bonds with Phil's new flame, but things turn awkward quickly.

episodes.title: Death by a Thousand Cold Cuts
episodes.summary: A big loss exposes bigger fissures in Ryan and Karen's relationship, and sends Karen seeking out some familiar comfort.

episodes.title: Ryan Joins the Crips
episodes.summary: Ryan explores a new romantic opportunity but is caught off guard by a surprising dilemma. A destitute Kim is forced to move back in with her parents.

episodes.title: Prom Queens
episodes.summary: Tensions simmer as Kim's family celebrates Diwali, while things get super awkward at the "Crips Prom" between Ryan's new friends and his date.

episodes.title: Why Is No One Ready?
episodes.summary: A weekend getaway proves anything but relaxing for Ryan and Tanner, as Karen takes a long-overdue trip herself. Kim and Ravi examine their relationship.

episodes.title: Here's Where the Story Ends
episodes.summary: As Olivia's wedding arrives, Ryan, Kim and Karen find themselves facing tough changes — but also discovering opportunities that may be truly special.
